- platform: "Playstation" (required)
- mission: optional, but the user mentioned "different missions" so I should probably call this without specifying a mission to get all missions
- trophy: optional, but the user mentioned "different trophies" so I should probably call this without specifying a trophy to get all trophies

Since the user wants information about different missions and trophies, I should make the call without specifying mission and trophy parameters to get the general rewards information for the game and platform.
